description: Milk, cheese, yogurt, butter and other dairy products; aligned to FoodKeeper Dairy Products & Eggs.

Products sold frozen; aligned to the FoodKeeper Food Purchased Frozen category.
Commercial and prepared baby foods; aligned to FoodKeeper Baby Food.
Bakery, baking/cooking and refrigerated-dough products; aligned to FoodKeeper Baked Goods.
Condiments, sauces and canned products; aligned to FoodKeeper.
Dry or prepared grains, beans and pasta; aligned to FoodKeeper.
